bottomLine.text: **Amplifier-not-originator survives — and is now computed, not eyeballed.** The pass-1 earliest-instance audit (claim_01) holds for claim-bearing items; the `analysis/textreuse.py` run adds 11 cross-account near-duplicate edges (Jaccard ≥ 0.80 over 5-gram shingles, n=4,359) showing the lane republishes shared upstream — e.g. a `@jacksonhinkle` item and Sulaiman's "JUAT IN: Yemeni ballistic missiles" item are 0.83 near-duplicates 2h apart. Reading narrowed honestly: the phase-2b sample also shows plain original slogans (no attached claim) — the amplifier finding is scoped to claim-bearing BREAKING items.

**Jvnior's output mix inverts in the recent window (claim_14, new).** Phase-2b sample (2026-09-02..06, 200 items): **54% high-arousal Israel/Jews/Zionist/Gaza conflict content vs 13.5% faith/lifestyle** — the reverse of the pass-1 T0 reading (see §3). Lane comparison in the same window: Awesome_Jew_ 31.5%, ShaykhSulaiman 29.5%, Haqiqatjou 22.5%, sneako 11.5%, Galloway 5.5%. Sample-descriptive only (adversarial caveat in §8).

**Monetization finding corrected, not overturned (claim_03 + claim_13).** The Rainbet gambling sponsorship was bio-disclosed in August 2026 and is externally corroborated (Track B E4 M1: bio mirror + trade press). **By 2026-09-06 the live bio no longer displays the Rainbet line or promos email**, consistent with the recorded X demonetization of the account on 2026-04-25 after an Eyal Yakoby flag (JFeed 2026-04-27 via E4). Sponsorship is historical, not current-tense.

**No coordination claim is publishable beyond candidate-signal strength.** The computed suite yields 22 candidate edges (strongest multi-trace: `ShaykhSulaiman`↔`jacksonhinkle` and `WelcomeTheGulag`↔`jacksonhinkle`↔`georgegalloway` images+co-url, Bonferroni p=0.0029) — but with **no matched organic control group**, the Pantè et al. 2025 (arXiv:2502.17344, pr_0015) checklist caps everything at candidate/medium. **No `inferred_coordination` edge is asserted in this case.** The strongest overlaps sit on the case-01 axis (Hinkle/Gulag/Galloway), which is a cross-case pointer, not a within-lane finding.

**Community Notes materially bite in this lane (F13 join).** 85 of 4,409 content items carry ≥1 note (215 note-tweet pairs; 210 statuses resolved). Highlights: a **HELPFUL-rated note on a Sneako item stating the quoted "SNEAKO has never said this"** (fabricated quote); a **misinformation-classifying note on Jvnior's "Netanyahu says Turkey must be destroyed" BREAKING** ("Netanyahu says nothing about destroying Turkey" — NEEDS_MORE_RATINGS); a note on Jvnior's Valencia-plane "50 Israeli terrorists" item dating the video to a July 2025 French campers incident; a doctored-screenshot note on a Sneako analytics item.

**Controls behave as controls.** Reuters/cnnbrk: 100% wire cadence; AvichayAdraee/UNRWA/haaretzcom/timesofisrael: institutional register, near-zero high-arousal share; Gaza-journalist controls (@AbujomaaGaza, @Hind_Gaza) post minutes-old self-sourced items without the seeds' flag-emoji/BREAKING format. The lane's style signature is not a "Gaza posting" artifact — it is specific to the personal-brand accounts.

limitations: Cache-first deep pagination (`next_cursor` followed; page caps documented per handle in `harvest_plan_phase2b.yaml`); proper csv-quoting rebuild (`build_data.py`, additive schema, batch ids); Community Notes corpus join with status history (`cn_join.py`, 4,409/4,409 covered); deterministic interpretive tables (`update_tables.py`); analysis suite (`analysis.run_all`, synchrony at 200 nulls — documented reduction from the 10,000 default; coordination at the mandated permutation count; figures into `figures/`). Own phase-2b spend: **$0.5971** (151 ledger lines, all replayable at $0; shared phase2b total $1.7028 against the $1.50 cap). Exhaustion notes recorded for both shells (0 posts). Power notes: the Nawfal zero-reciprocation scan is powered to ≥2% mention rate at n=200 (~100 posts/day); the Jvnior share claim carries a newest-first recency caveat and control comparison; every negative finding in this case is published at medium or lower, or carries an explicit power note.

Limitations: no matched organic control set for the coordination suite (caps all edges at candidate strength); video contents unverified; Arabic reply-mining shallow; newest-first 200-item samples under-cover slow accounts (JvniorTrades 19 items in-window; window coverage per handle recorded in build logs); MotasemADalloul→AbujomaaGaza rename is probable, not proven.
unknowns: Jvnior real-world identity beyond the bio persona (no interview located; do not speculate — E4 concurs).
Truthteller operator identity; the $1,000-unblock fee (single-source, not-addressed-externally).

**Closed (Phase 3, 2026-09-06):** the 26 disconfirming queries were re-run live, 26/26 executed; Arabic set 20+19 hits, Hebrew/Farsi executed with zero hits (§10). One-page samples with `has_next_page=true` remain capped, not exhausted.
Sulaiman's Iran items vs PressTV/Mehr/ISNA wording (textreuse across group-07's harvest — cross-case task).
Landis triplicate re-verification over a window covering 2026-08-25.
Full 45-row control roster harvest (8 harvested; deferral below).
contradictions: 26 disconfirming queries were **written and documented** in `evidence/api/search_phase2b.json`; the shared phase2b cap ($1.50) was **exhausted by the parallel case-01/case-02 agents** ($1.70 total phase2b spend vs the $1.50 cap; exhausted at 2026-09-06T08:27Z), so all 26 executed as budget-refused at the time. **Phase 3 re-ran all 26 live (2026-09-06, PHASE3-REPORT §4; `evidence/api/phase3_contradiction_*.json`, source `src_phase3_reruns`): 26/26 executed, 0 refusals.** The multilingual set is closed: `ar_core` 20 hits, `ar_reply_mirror` 19, `he_core` 0, `fa_core` 0 — the Hebrew and Farsi queries were *executed with zero hits*, not deferred. Two re-runs changed the record (see §3 and `ingest_phase3.py`): `c03a` surfaced Jvnior's 2026-08-28 Rainbet exit statement and his 2026-07-30 account of the deal (claim_03), and `c02a`/`c02b` surfaced 2023-10..2024-06 posts in which Nawfal credits Sulaiman as a source and moderator, so claim_02 ("hostile one-way, not collaboration") is now window-scoped to 2026 — the hostility is a turn, not a constant. Per plan §7 the pass had continued offline: every material claim carries ≥2 stored contradicting rows (`data/claim_evidence.csv`, 46 rows) built from (a) the phase-2b datasets themselves (e.g. zero-mention scan of Nawfal's 200 items against the feud reading; live-bio re-check against current-tense sponsorship; Kirk-mention scan across 1,000 lane items), (b) Track B E4/E3 outputs (Rainbet M1–M3, identity lookalike checks, fact-check absence record fc_absence_sneako_jvnior_gage), and (c) the mandated adversarial reviewer arXiv:2502.17344 (pr_0015, retrieved primary document) applied to every coordination-adjacent reading. The Arabic (`غزة OR فلسطين OR إبادة`), Hebrew (`ישראל OR עזה`), and Persian (`اسرائیل OR غزه`) probe queries were executed in Phase 3 (20+19 hits for Arabic, zero hits for Hebrew and Persian); documented as executed results rather than deferred stubs.
